value.title: Estates General (France)
value.snippet: In France under the ancien régime, the Estates General (French: États généraux [eta ʒeneʁo] ) or States-General was a legislative and consultative assembly

value.title: Estates General of 1789
value.snippet: The Estates General of 1789 (French: États Généraux de 1789) was a general assembly representing the French estates of the realm: the clergy (First Estate)
